constraints.note: Stories should be linked to a parent Epic. The epic key must exist — verify with the user before creating; a wrong/nonexistent key errors or auto-links to the wrong epic.

transitions.note: Lifecycle transitions for TOMATORIAL. ALWAYS fetch getTransitionsForJiraIssue and match by to.name — the id fields here are hints only, never hardcode them. Transition screens may require fields the metadata reports as optional; those are listed under requiredFields and MUST be supplied or the transition 400s.

In Progress.trigger: work begins on the ticket (branch cut, or user says start work). If already In Progress (Jira GitHub integration may auto-move on branch/PR link), do nothing.

Code Review.trigger: a PR is opened for the ticket.
Code Review.fetchNote: Fetch with expand: transitions.fields and includeUnavailableTransitions: true — the Code Review transition may not appear in the short list.

customfield_14226.name: QA Notes
customfield_14226.note: REJECTS a plain string ('Operation value must be an Atlassian Document'). Wrap in ADF doc. Content per templates/qa-notes.md: numbered test steps for user-facing changes, or 'Covered by regression.' when nothing is user-testable.

customfield_13504.name: Covered Information Data Inventory
customfield_13504.note: PII checklist. Reported optional by metadata but the transition 400s without it. Default 'No Impact' for changes touching no personal data; pick matching option(s) from allowedValues if PII is involved.

Blocked.trigger: work is stuck on an external dependency.

resolution.name: Resolution
resolution.note: Closing requires a resolution. Done = { id: '10000' }.
